items.example: This phone is better than my old one.
The traffic is worse today.

items.en: A is + adj-er than B: It's bigger than mine.
items.example: My new flat is bigger than my old one.

items.en: more + adj + than: It's more expensive than that one.
items.example: This bag is more expensive than that one.
I feel much better today.
items.exampleTr: Bugün kendimi çok daha iyi hissediyorum.
items.note: 'much' karşılaştırmayı güçlendirir: much bigger, much easier.

items.en: as + adj + as: It's as good as the old one.
items.example: This café is as good as the other one.

items.en: It's not as good as I thought.
items.example: The film wasn't as good as I thought.

items.en: the most + adj: It's the most comfortable chair.
items.example: This is the most comfortable chair in the office.
items.note: Kısa sıfatlarda: the biggest, the cheapest.

items.example: Our phones are very similar.
What's the difference between these two?
Your bag is the same as mine!
Let's compare the prices first.
I prefer walking to taking the bus.

items.en: I prefer X to Y: I prefer tea to coffee.
items.example: I prefer tea to coffee.

items.en: Which one do you like better?
items.example: Which one do you like better, the red or the blue?
items.exampleTr: Hangisini daha çok beğeniyorsun, kırmızıyı mı maviyi mi?

items.example: Taking the metro is easier than driving.
items.exampleTr: Metroyla gitmek araba sürmekten daha kolay.

items.example: This shop is very convenient for me.
items.exampleTr: Bu dükkan benim için çok elverişli.

items.example: The food was quite good.
It's a bit more expensive, but it's worth it.
This one is slightly bigger.
This is my favourite place in the city.
Wow, that's way better than before!
items.exampleTr: Vay, bu öncekinden çok daha iyi!

items.example: The food was just average.
